This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Meet Cambodia's "Frankengun" — a one-of-a-kind rifle combining a Colt M16 core modified for .22 Long Rifle, Chinese Type 56 barrel components, and a Soviet AKM wooden buttstock. This unique hybrid firearm is housed at a shooting club in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, and is even available to rent. Discover the strange story behind this custom rifle at Simple History.
